description: Stage 3b minimal shared frame-convergence: stable accepted growth at the requested origin learns a conservative minimum and changes the next tiled target; a contradictory declared maximum never learns. Core (world_frame_policy_tests) and Windows production sequencing (world_diff_tests) consume the SAME cases through the raw FrameAttempt/report path with separate runners. Fixture track hints are not programmatic clamps; the live clamp predicate stays offline.
